name: Shinshoku 2 ~Inma no Ikenie~
source:
There is a magic book secretly kept in the library. One day, Chisa finds it by chance. When she opens it, a monster comes out and rapes her....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081030015017/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008168]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
图书馆里秘密保存着一本魔法书。有一天，千纱偶然发现了它。当她打开它时，一个怪物出来并强奸了她……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081030015017/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008168]工口游戏商店[/url]]
